test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: **kengaroo**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling should be **'kangaroo'.**
 
• **'Kangaroo'** is a large Australian mammal with a long stiff tail, short front legs and long powerful back legs.
 
 
• **Example -** *The **kangaroo** lives in droves in the open grassy plains.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1** which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vivacious** means attractively lively and animated (typically used for a woman).
 
• **Ambiguous** means open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
 
• **Itinerary** means a travel document recording a route or journey.
